ARTY and SOXX are the ETFs I currently follow as they have shown proven results over the past one and five years. The first ETF follows the MorningStar Global Artificial Intelligence Select Index, and the other mirrors the NYSE Biotechnology Index. I usually receive stronger results when index funds and ETFs follow very broad-based indices vs more thematic funds more diversified in smaller and mid-cap companies.   

I will use thematic ETFs to generate ideas in choosing individual equities and then follow up with looking at their peer performers to make more targeted equity investments.
